name: TesselationWrapper
description:
Handle the triangulation of spheres in a scene, build tesselation on request, and give access to computed quantities (see also the dedicated section in user manual <MicroStressAndMicroStrain>). The calculation of microstrain is explained in [Catalano2014a]_ 

See example usage in script...

attributes.name: alphaCapsVol
attributes.description: The volume of the packing as defined by the boundary alpha cap polygons

attributes.name: far
attributes.description: Defines the radius of the large virtual spheres used to define nearly flat boundaries around the assembly. The radius will be the (scene's) bounding box size multiplied by 'far'. Higher values will minimize the error theoretically (since the infinite sphere really defines a plane), but it may increase numerical errors at some point. The default should give a resonable compromize.

attributes.name: groupMask
attributes.description: Bitmask for filtering spheres, ignored if 0.

attributes.name: mma
attributes.description: underlying object processing the data - see specific settings in

methods.name: addBoundingPlane
methods.description: add a bounding plane (in fact a sphere with very large radius) bounding the spheres along the direction 'axis' (0,1,2), on the 'positive' or negative side.

methods.name: applyAlphaForces
methods.description: set permanent forces based on stress using an alpha shape

methods.name: applyAlphaVel
methods.description: set velocities based on a velocity gradient tensor using an alpha shape

methods.name: calcAlphaStress
methods.description: get the Love-Weber average of the Cauchy stress on the polyhedral caps associated to boundary particles

methods.name: calcVolPoroDef
methods.description: Return a table with per-sphere computed quantities. Include deformations on the increment defined by states 0 and 1 if deformation=True (make sure to define states 0 and 1 consistently).

methods.name: computeDeformations
methods.description: compute per-particle deformation. Get it with TesselationWrapper::deformation (id,i,j).

methods.name: computeVolumes
methods.description: compute volumes of all Voronoi's cells.

methods.name: defToVtk
methods.description: Write local deformations in vtk format from states 0 and 1.

methods.name: defToVtkFromPositions
methods.description: Write local deformations in vtk format from positions files (one sphere per line, with x,y,z,rad separated by spaces).

methods.name: defToVtkFromStates
methods.description: Write local deformations in vtk format from state files (since the file format is very special, consider using defToVtkFromPositions if the input files were not generated by TesselationWrapper).

methods.name: deformation
methods.description: Get individual components of the particle deformation tensors

methods.name: deformationTensor
methods.description: Get particle deformation (tensor)

methods.name: getAlphaCaps
methods.description: Get the list of area vectors for the polyhedral caps associated to boundary particles ('extended' alpha-contour). If alpha is not specified or null the minimum alpha resulting in a unique connected domain is used. Taking a smaller 'shrinked' alpha for placing the virtual spheres moves the enveloppe outside the packing, It should be ~(alpha-refRad) typically.

methods.name: getAlphaFaces
methods.description: Get the list of alpha faces for a given alpha. If alpha is not specified or null the minimum alpha resulting in a unique connected domain is used

methods.name: getAlphaGraph
methods.description: Get the list of area vectors for the polyhedral caps associated to boundary particles ('extended' alpha-contour). If alpha is not specified or null the minimum alpha resulting in a unique connected domain is used

methods.name: getAlphaVertices
methods.description: Get the list of 'alpha' bounding spheres for a given alpha. If alpha is not specified or null the minimum alpha resulting in a unique connected domain is used. This function is generating a new alpha shape for each call, not to be used intensively.

methods.name: getVolPoroDef
methods.description: |ydeprecated| see new name TesselationWrapper.calcVolPoroDef

methods.name: loadState
methods.description: Load a file with positions to define state 0 or 1.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Save a file with positions, can be later reloaded in order to define state 0 or 1.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Make the current state of the simulation the initial (0) or final (1) configuration for the definition of displacement increments, use only state=0 if you just want to get  volmumes and porosity. Exclude bodies using the bitmask TesselationWrapper::groupMask.

methods.name: testAlphaShape
methods.description: transitory function, testing AlphaShape feature

methods.name: triangulate
methods.description: triangulate spheres of the packing

methods.name: volume
methods.description: Returns the volume of Voronoi's cell of a sphere.
